caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular block of wood with a rough texture and brown color, lying at an angle on a plain, light beige background. On top of the wooden block, there are two metallic objects: one is a flower-shaped ornament with pointed petals, colored in shades of gray and slightly purple, with outlines accented in black; the other object appears to be a leaf-shaped ornament in similar colors, placed next to the flower, both oriented diagonally on the surface of the wood. The center area of the page contains the words "WELLINGTON BLEWETT" typed in uppercase letters below the wooden block. The overall composition is centered, leaving much open space around the depicted objects.
title: Resist Pattern (Daisy)
